title: OSHA GHS Training Is Now Available On HCP
titleTag: OSHA GHS Training Is Now Available On HCP
description: You can now train on the new OSHA Globally Harmonized System for Hazard Communication.
body:
The new OSHA Globally Harmonized System for Hazard Communication that was recently adopted and mandated by OSHA is now available to you through Healthcare Compliance Pros. The new GHS information has been incorporated into your current OSHA online training.

The deadline set by OSHA to train your employees on the signs and symbols used in this new program is December 1, 2013. Even though this deadline may seem like it is in the distant future, it is imperative that your employees train on this new program in order for you to ensure a safe and healthy work environment for them.

For clients who have already trained their employees in OSHA this year, we will also be posting articles throughout the year covering GHS and the upcoming new requirements. Comment and let us know if you have any questions or give us a call.
